_meta.preparedBy: coding agent (Claude), from general knowledge of Kenyan public symbols
_meta.caveat: Whether a level is expected to have a flag or an emblem. The country has both; the 47 counties have adopted county flags and coats of arms (a few may not have published one, which the per-unit marker records as none); constituencies and wards have no official flag or emblem as a rule, so no search is queued for them. A unit can still be marked has when evidence shows otherwise.
